messages:
rene: Dropping a new concept for the latency panel: CDF with shaded percentile bands (50/75/90/99) + pointer for selected time window. Mock: https://redwood.design/cdf-percentile gabe: Nice for trend reading. two immediate asks: 1) add a units control so folks can pick ms / s, 2) make it obvious when values are clipped (we often cap at 99.9) mira: Smoothing note: CDF gets noisy with sparse buckets. prefer a light kernel smoothing for the bands but make it toggleable. default = off for hardcore SREs sam: Outlier handling: instead of clipping silently, show a small badge on the chart header "clipped to 99.9%" and render the clipped mass as a separate dotted marker on the right rene: Agreed. tooltip behavior: hover a percentile band -> show percentile label, absolute value in chosen units, and whether that value is clipped with original value in parentheses if clipped gabe: Axis debate: some PMs want linear axis, others want log for long-tail visibility. Could we add a scale toggle (linear / log) and update tick formatting accordingly? If log, annotate in axis label: "log scale" mira: A11y: contrast between band fills is low for colorblind palettes at small widths. use patterned fills (diagonal hatch) for alternating bands and ensure patterns collapse gracefully at small sizes. SR text should be descriptive: include median & p95 and note clipping when present sam: Copy nit for legend helper: change to "Units used by axis and tooltips" instead of just "Units". Also the scale toggle helper should read "Axis scale (linear/log)" design-bot: Tasks added T-2278: units dropdown, scale toggle, smoothing toggle, clipping badge + dotted mass render, patterned fills for a11y, SR summary + aria-describedby link rene: example ARIA we can reuse:
gabe: small interaction ask: keyboard focus should move between percentile bands and read the percentile + value via aria-live so screen-reader users can explore without a mouse mira: I'll add Storybook stories: linear vs log, with/without smoothing, clipping on/off. Also add axe snapshots to catch patterned-fill regressions sam: :thumbsup: one final formatting nit - when units = seconds, format ticks with 2 decimals for subsecond values to avoid confusion
